how_to_apply: The notification does not provide an online application form or portal. Candidates apply by emailing the scanned application and then sending the original documents by post. The official page for notices is www.esic.gov.in/recruitments.
Visit www.esic.gov.in/recruitments between the 1st and 7th of the month and check the vacancy notification.
Fill in the prescribed application format in black or blue ink in BLOCK letters, with a recent self-attested passport-size photograph. File a separate form for each post.

Scan the application form, the Demand Draft (where applicable) and all self-attested supporting documents, including research publications and conference papers, if any. Arrange them in the checklist order as a PDF only.

Email them to [email protected] by 4:00 PM on the 15th of the month (or the next working day if it is a holiday). Write the Name, Post and Department in the email subject. Emails after the deadline are not accepted.

Send the original application form with self-attested documents and the original Demand Draft (if applicable) to The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Nanda Nagar, Indore (M.P.) - 452011, to reach on or before the interview date (the 17th of every month, as written in the notification).
Write "Recruitment of Teaching Faculty/Senior Residents on contract basis" with the Name of Post and Department on the envelope.
Report for the walk-in interview at 9:00 AM with original documents for verification. For October 2026, the interview is on 19/10/2026.
Self-attested copies of the following must be attached with the application. Items (i) to (xi) are verified against the originals before the interview.
Class 10th certificate (for date of birth)
All marks sheets, attempt details and degree certificate of MBBS
All marks sheets, attempt details and degree certificate of MD/MS/DNB or other examination
Valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD certificate in the Central Government job format
Updated State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate
Proof of publication(s)
Experience certificate
Recent passport-size photograph
Relieving/NOC certificate from previous or current employer, if applicable
Aadhaar card
Completion certificate of the ICMR/NMC-conducted bio-medical research examination, if any
NMC-approved Revised/Basic Medical Education Workshop completion certificate, if any

The application format asks for: post applied for, department, name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age as on the 15th of the month, category and caste, post notified under category, mode of interview (offline), Demand Draft details (bank name, DD number, date), qualifications table (qualification, board/university, year of passing, marks, division, attempts), experience with certificates, MCI/State registration number, telephone and mobile numbers, email, permanent and present addresses, marital status, nationality and mother tongue, Aadhaar number, identification mark, and a signed declaration.

The enclosure checklist covers: date of birth certificate (matriculation), proof of identity (Aadhaar/PAN/driving licence/other), UG certificate, Diploma/PG certificate, MCI/State registration certificate, experience certificate/NOC, research publications, caste/EWS/PwD certificate, and residential address proof.
Fill only one form for each post applied for, in clear and bold letters.
The photograph must show the face and both ears clearly and be signed across.
Send all self-attested documents as PDF only, in checklist order, by 4:00 PM on the 15th. No email is accepted after that.
Canvassing in any form will debar the candidature at any stage.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates should check their own eligibility before reporting for the interview. Eligibility for the qualifying degree and experience is counted as on the 15th of every month. Interview opportunity is provisional, subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility. Candidates must hold an updated Medical Registration (NMC or State Medical Council) with all post-MBBS, MD or MS qualifications. If the registration is not updated, candidates must show and submit a copy of the "Applied for" document at the time of interview. Otherwise they may not be interviewed, or their result may be withheld. Selected candidates must submit the updated Medical Registration Certificate when reporting to join. Candidates working in a Govt., Autonomous, Statutory or Private institution should preferably bring an NOC from their employer. If it is not immediately available, they should submit a copy of the "applied for NOC". Candidates already working at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Indore need not produce an NOC. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty Qualification
content_sections.text: The educational qualification is as per National Medical Commission (NMC, erstwhile MCI) guidelines. The notification does not list post-wise degrees or experience requirements, so refer to the NMC guidelines for each post and department. The self-attested documents required with the application cover the MBBS and MD/MS/DNB or other qualifications, marks sheets, attempts and degree certificates (see the documents section below). Under ESIC Headquarters memoranda dated 22.01.2018 and 28.10.2020, a candidate eligible for a higher post (Professor or Associate Professor) may be interviewed against a lower post (Associate Professor or Assistant Professor). If selected, such a candidate may be placed with a suitable upgradation of the lower post, as per eligibility and the selection board's recommendation. The upgradation is temporary and limited to the tenure of the teaching faculty, or until a regular incumbent is appointed to the lower post. In Super Specialty departments, if no suitable or eligible candidate appears, a candidate eligible for a lower post (Assistant Professor or Associate Professor) may be interviewed against Associate Professor or Professor. If selected, the candidate is appointed to the lower post with suitable down-gradation. In Super Specialty departments, if no suitable candidate appears for an advertised post, the Selection Board may relax the experience criteria and allow such candidates to be interviewed. Selection is then as per the board's recommendation.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty Salary
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is as per Medical Administration, HQRS Office Memoranda No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt. File) dated 13.04.2022 (other than retired Army Medical Teachers) and Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022. It may change as per Headquarters instructions issued from time to time. Salary and other allowances are paid as: NPA at 20% (wherever applicable and admissible), DA at 60%, HRA at 20%, and TA at Rs. 7,200 plus DA thereon. The remuneration is revised automatically when the Dearness Allowance rate is revised, effective from the date of notification of Government orders. Arrears are not admissible for retrospective rate revisions.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: Tenure is 1 year, or until a regular incumbent joins, or until 70 years of age, whichever is earlier. Either side may end the contract with one month's prior notice without assigning a reason. In case of spot resignation, one month's salary is to be deposited to the ESI Account through challan. No service benefits such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority or Promotion are admissible. Absence beyond 7 days without proper permission counts as voluntary abandonment and leads to automatic termination. Attendance must be marked manually and on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily on scheduled working days. Leave of 2.5 days is credited for each completed month. No other leave (Earned Leave, Special Casual Leave, Commuted Leave) is allowed. Sunday and holiday duty is by rotation. Selected Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors and Senior Residents must deposit Rs. 20,000/- as a security deposit. It is forfeited if the candidate resigns or leaves within six months of joining, if the institute terminates the contract, or in case of automatic termination for absence beyond 7 days. Candidates involved in patient care must hold a professional indemnity policy covering the contract period. The minimum sum assured per annum is Rs. 30 lakhs for Anaesthesiology, ENT, Eye, Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Surgery, Accident & Emergency, ICU, Cardiology, Medical Oncology, Nephrology, Gastroenterology, Neurology, Surgical Oncology, Urology, Rheumatology, Haematology and Anaesthesiology with Surgical Super Speciality. It is Rs. 20 lakhs for Chest, and Rs. 10 lakhs for Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology, Dermatology, Radiology, Psychiatry and Dental. A copy of the insurance and premium receipt must be submitted within 7 days of engagement, otherwise service is terminated. The contract is signed on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 500/- (or as applicable under the Stamp Act). The selected candidate brings the blank stamp paper, purchased between the date the result is issued and the date of reporting. The original agreement stays with ESIC and a copy goes to the candidate. Other terms and conditions apply as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Indore has released Rolling Advertisement No. 08 of 2026 to recruit 86 Teaching Faculty (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and Senior Residents on a contractual basis through monthly walk-in interviews.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 86 vacancies are available across various clinical and non-clinical departments for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit scanned applications via email by 04:00 PM on the 15th of every month. For October 2026, the application deadline is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. When and where are the walk-in interviews conducted?
faq.answer: Walk-in interviews are conducted offline on the 18th of every month (or the next working day if the 18th is a holiday) at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Indore. For October 2026, the interview is on 19/10/2026 with reporting time at 09:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Teaching Faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess qualifications as per National Medical Commission (NMC erstwhile MCI) guidelines along with an updated Medical Registration certificate from the NMC or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Senior Residents is not exceeding 45 years as on the 15th of every month, with age relaxations as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is ₹500/- for all other categories. SC, ST, ESIC regular employees, defence ex-servicemen, and PwD candidates are exempt from paying the fee (Nil fee).

faq.question: Q8. How should the application fee be paid?
faq.answer: The application fee must be paid through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of 'ESI Fund A/c No.-1, payable at Indore'.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professors receive a fixed basic pay of ₹67,700.00 at Pay Level 11 under the 7th CPC, along with admissible allowances such as NPA, DA, HRA, and TA.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must submit a separate application form and fee for each post applied for.
